answer: Locks are written down in pearl, expire in ember, and terrace lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 15 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 169 aliases as a result needs 177 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4939 identities would post 500 proofs and burn roughly 32 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
